mapper.select: SELECT 0 AS position,'callback_pending' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(received_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT received_at FROM tc_refund_callback FORCE INDEX(ix_refund_callback_observation) WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY received_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_callback_pending UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS position,'callback_review' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(received_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT received_at FROM tc_refund_callback FORCE INDEX(ix_refund_callback_observation) WHERE status='REVIEW' ORDER BY received_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_callback_review ORDER BY position
